name: SALMA (SDWAN Asset License Management)
description: Handled UI slicing from prototype to production-ready pages and integrated external project APIs. On the backend, built the inventory analytics menu showing which assets are synced versus not yet synced, developed a public-facing API for external consumption, and handled bug fixing.

name: SDWAN Dashboard
description: Developed the Proactive Ticket menu and built a microservice to resolve PDF export reporting issues. Redesigned the SDWAN portal's data-collection architecture — replacing direct per-device polling with a job scheduler across all integrated devices — reducing server load and speeding up data collection for PDF report generation. Also handled ongoing bug fixes.

name: WFMTA (Workforce Management)
description: Developed several application features and menus, fixed bugs, and monitored application health using the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log analysis.

name: FlowForge
description: Self-hosted, real-time multi-tenant workflow orchestration engine — a blend of Zapier's workflow simplicity and GitHub Actions' execution model. Built the workflow engine, trigger/action node system, and multi-tenant isolation, with Claude AI integrated for AI-assisted workflow steps.

name: Plantation Block System
description: Palm oil plantation block management app — built REST APIs, real-time updates via SSE, and an interactive map for visualizing plantation blocks. Covers the full stack from Laravel/Inertia backend to Vue 3 frontend, complete with unit tests and a CI/CD pipeline.
